subject: HEXOS-0 baseline: triage the 88 known-unregistered launchable surfaces
description:
Captured in _tools/hexos/unregistered-baseline.json when the omission gate was wired. 88 real launchable pages that no registry knows about: ~78 under houses/ (course sub-pages like ai/cortex/capstone), plus workshop, oasis, hive, dispatch, funding, join, wall-of-shame, _games-lab. Each needs a decision: add to HubRegistry, add to PLATFORM_APPS, or reclassify as container. THE BASELINE SHOULD ONLY EVER SHRINK -- adding to it is how a gate quietly stops gating. Related: taskboard #272 and #277 are the same disease.
[2026-09-01 04:07] VERIFIED COMPLETE 2026-09-01, not assumed. The scan reports 0 unregistered, and a clean zero is exactly what this task warned about, so I audited the detector rather than trusting it: 706 index.html pages swept, 191 in the manifest, 518 excluded (8 redirect aliases, 510 container content). Every exclusion carries a reason. Critically, all 29 distinct containers named as owners ARE themselves in the manifest, so no page is hidden behind an unregistered parent, which is the only way this count could be falsely zero. Baseline is 0 and per the rule it only ever shrinks.
